name: Pomodoro mini timer with native PIP

mentions.name: Pomodoro mini timer with native PIP
mentions.description: A pomodoro mini timer that uses native Picture-in-Picture (PIP) for an always-on-top display and can be installed as a PWA.
mentions.problem: Most pomodoro timers the author has used don't play nice with getting a tiny window size in the corner of the monitor.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on a new pomodoro mini timer that uses native PIP for an always on top display, and can be installed as a PWA.

Most that I have used don't play nice with trying to get a tiny window size in the corner of my monitor.
